# AMA Solutions Corp

> Agentic delivery corporation. We bring people, specialized agent teams,
> technical capabilities, and operating playbooks together to turn ambitious
> ideas into scoped, reviewable work.

## What we do

AMA Solutions Corp is the commercial entity and client-facing front door for
a network of 12 specialized Art Mob teams. Each Mob is a focused delivery unit
built around a specific domain. Clients engage one Mob or a combination to scope
and deliver a defined body of work.

Delivery areas include strategy and brand, content and storytelling, digital
product, operations and systems, data and intelligence, and more. Human review
and client accountability are part of every engagement.

## The 12 Art Mob teams

Each Mob is a domain-focused delivery unit. The design calls for 144 positions
across the 12 Mobs. Active deployment details are verified separately from this
document.

- Mob 01 · Strategy & Brand
- Mob 02 · Content & Storytelling
- Mob 03 · Digital Product
- Mob 04 · Operations & Systems
- Mob 05 · Data & Intelligence
- Mob 06 · Growth & Community
- Mob 07 · Finance & Capital
- Mob 08 · Legal & Compliance
- Mob 09 · Learning & Education
- Mob 10 · Creative Technology
- Mob 11 · Infrastructure & DevOps
- Mob 12 · Global Logistics & Trade

## HAMAL

HAMAL is the coordinating intelligence layer connecting AMA's delivery network.
It maintains shared context, playbooks, and orchestration across the Mobs.

## Foundry OS

Foundry OS is a modular operating system for agent-enabled work, currently in
development. Licensing is a longer-term objective.

## Who engages AMA

- Clients: organizations with a delivery challenge for one or more Mobs
- Strategic partners: agencies, platforms, or vendors for co-delivery
- Investors: early-stage investors aligned with the agentic services thesis

## Contact

Web: https://amasolagi.com/contact
Inquiries are routed to a human. No automated outbound communications.
